naming_rules.rule: Precision mobile 4-digit number, 1st digit = class: 3 = entry (3xxx), 5 = thin mainstream (5530-5770 share chassis with XPS 15/17), 7 = full-power 'ultimate' (7xxx).

3rd digit = generation/model year: 3 = 2018 (Intel 8th gen), 4 = 2019 (9th gen; 3540 still 8th-gen U), 5 = 2020 (10th), 6 = 2021 (11th), 7 = 2022 (12th), 8 = 2023 (13th), 9 = 2024 (Core Ultra Meteor Lake). 1 and 2 were 2015-2017 (5510/7510, 5520/7520).

4th digit: 0 = normal model. 1 exists only in the 3000 series (3541, 3551, 3561, 3571, 3581, 3591): same 15.6" chassis as the '0' sibling, but 35-45W H-series CPU (Xeon option) and a stronger NVIDIA GPU. The '0' sibling uses 15W U/P CPUs. It does NOT simply mean 'has NVIDIA': 3550/3560/3570/3580/3590 also offer NVIDIA (P520/T500/T550/A500/RTX 500 Ada). Only the 3540 used AMD (WX 2100). 5xxx/7xxx always end in 0.
Watch out: 'Precision 5530 2-in-1' (2018, Kaby Lake-G i5-8305G/i7-8706G, Radeon Pro WX Vega M) is a different machine from the Precision 5530 clamshell.

Jan 2025 rebrand: three families. Dell = consumer, Dell Pro = business, Dell Pro Max = maximum performance (replaces Precision mobile workstations). Tiers: Base (no suffix) / Plus ('most scalable performance') / Premium ('ultimate in mobility and design'). The number in the name is the screen size: Pro Max 14, 16, 18.
The Register: the Precision brand was dropped in the Jan 2025 rebrand. Pro Max covers high-end users.

Model code format [brand][tier][size][year][platform], e.g. MC14250. Brand letter: D = Dell, P = Dell Pro, M = Dell Pro Max. Tier letter: A = Premium, B = Plus, C = Base. Two digits = screen size (14/16/18). Next two digits = model year (25 = 2025). Last digit = platform: 0 = Intel, 5 = AMD (PB14255 = Dell Pro 14 Plus with AMD Ryzen PRO; MC16255 = Pro Max 16 AMD). Dell publishes no decoder. This is inferred from Dell's own product names (MC14250 Pro Max 14, MC16250 Pro Max 16, MB16250 Pro Max 16 Plus, MB18250 Pro Max 18 Plus, MA14250 Pro Max 14 Premium, MA16250 Pro Max 16 Premium, PA14250 Pro 14 Premium, PB14250 Pro 14 Plus, DA14250 Dell 14 Premium, DB14250 Dell 14 Plus).

2026: the Precision name came back as 'Dell Pro Precision 5 Series / 7 Series' (announced 16 Mar 2026, Intel Core Ultra Series 3 + RTX PRO Blackwell). Codes: PW + series digit + size + 26 + 0, e.g. PW514260 (Pro Precision 5 14S), PW516260 (5 16S), PW714260 (7 14), PW716260 (7 16). This confirms that the '25/26' digits are the year. Pro Max continues alongside it (e.g. 2026 Pro Max 16 with AMD).

The bottom-label 'Regulatory Model' (e.g. P91F for the Precision 5550 generation) is a separate code, shared across generations. It is not the marketing model, so identify units by marketing name or service tag.
